subject: literacy
concept: Using sensory details (sight, sound, smell, touch) to make a setting feel real
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student describes a real or imagined place using at least two different senses aloud
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a setting description to the sense(s) it appeals to
exercise.abstract: Student writes a setting description using at least two sensory details

misconception_flags: describes only visual details, missing other senses entirely

interest_binding: setting generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
